hooks.text: 每项技能升级都可在强化原技能和追加链式技能之间二选一，决定专精单招或延长连段
hooks.excerpt: Rather than just acquiring new skills, Ovis Loop gives you the choice between passive and active upgrades for each skill. Decide to buff the skill you have, or add an additional chained skill to carry on carving your way through Doctor Wolf’s minions. Our skill and combo system allows you to play your way. Focus on strengthening just one skill, or embrace the dynamic force of the chain, it’s up to you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Boss会学习玩家习惯：偏闪避就持续追击，偏冲锋则主动后撤拉开距离
hooks.excerpt: Whether you like to charge in, use area of effect or dive in and out, each boss will adapt to meet your challenge. Focus on dodging and find a boss that aggressively pursues. If you prefer to rush in, it’ll retreat to find space.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Omega死亡后仍会进入下一次Loop，但本轮收集的所有改造都会丢失并以新配置重开
hooks.excerpt: One wrong move and while Omega will persist through death, any modifications collected will be lost as you hit a new Loop with a fresh loadout – it’s time to steel your woollen form, and protect the flock.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
